title: Oura Ring reveal
description: A wrapper that brings its content in as it scrolls into view: fade and a 20px rise (the default), a plain fade, or a blur-to-sharp fade for pictures. Runs over a fixed 200px of scroll; steps stagger it by 40px each. Pure CSS scroll-driven animation.
notes: browsers without animation-timeline, and reduced motion, show the content in place
don't put it inside an overflow-hidden box: use overflow-clip, or the timeline freezes
name: ouraring-reveal

props.name: kind
props.description: rise: fade + 20px lift (text) · fade: opacity only · blur: blurred to sharp (pictures)

props.name: step
props.description: stagger position: each step starts 40px of scroll later
